verdict_rule: REPRODUCTION cannot be PASS while any mandatory input is missing or unparseable, a gate did not reproduce, the stable-id equality is not literal, digest coverage is short, a negative went uncaught or unrestored, the product surface moved, a declared FAIL_OPEN finding stopped reproducing, or a prerequisite binding did not resolve. Reproducing a known fail-open refusal is a reproduced FINDING and is never rendered as a safety result. CLEAN_REPRODUCTION describes the reproduction, never the patchability model.

findings.means: the scorer refuses a predicted-patchable declaration that is not demonstrated: one partly stale, one wholly stale, one with no demonstration row
an injected admitted row is refused on each real corpus
both weakened readers fail the arms, so the suite is not vacuous

known_fail_open_findings.why_this_is_not_a_pass: These are refusals the programme depends on. If a clean rebuild stopped producing them the gate would be passing for the wrong reason, so ABSENT forces REPRODUCTION: FAIL.

entries.statement: A patch must be observable at every call site that reaches the patched member, including virtual and instance dispatch.
entries.why: G5's isolated experiment attached a patch to Base.work and the C++ invoke of the target returned PATCHED-w, yet viaVirtual still read OLD-w. So a call site reading OLD-w is not a failed attachment -- the attachment succeeded and the site does not observe it.
entries.observed_consequence: NOT_INLINED cannot be read as patchable. The banked contract is narrower: no covered body-copy mechanism was witnessed.

entries.statement: Deciding whether a compiled call site is redirectable must not depend on reading tagged entry-point offsets back out of a finished snapshot.
entries.why: UntaggedFunction::entry_point_@8 / unchecked_entry_point_@16 alias UntaggedCode::entry_point_@8 / monomorphic_entry_point_@16, so tagged #0x7 and #0xf are ambiguous between the two layouts. Only GenerateStaticDartCall's early return through FUNCTION_REG is redirectable; PC-relative branch and Code-pool slot forms are not.
entries.observed_consequence: The dispatch predicate fails closed rather than classifying, which is why the predictor admits zero declarations.

entries.statement: The Route-2 inlining note a release consumes must have been produced by that exact release, proven by digest, not by build recipe.
entries.why: The reader treats a note from any other build as unusable rather than approximate. A note that merely looks right is the one input that could turn UNKNOWN into a false patchable.
entries.observed_consequence: INLINING_EVIDENCE_RELEASE_MISMATCH is a live refusal code with a passing falsification arm, and the weakened predictor fails that same arm -- so the refusal is enforced, not decorative.

entries.statement: No cost decision may be made from a projection or from fixture-scale measurement; the figure must come from the scale being shipped.
entries.why: G4's own retention curve (40912 byte floor + ~82 bytes/member) projects 2,922,310 bytes where measurement found 4,330,120 -- low by 1.482x. Independently, the reader projection that was complete at 36 rows is incomplete at 35,139.
entries.observed_consequence: G7 reports cost rather than certifying affordability, and G5 classified REDUCE_SCOPE instead of extrapolating.

entries.statement: The max(stdev(A), stdev(B)) order-dependence rule may inform cost diagnosis and must not be cited as a safety or causality claim.
entries.why: PM ruling on G7. At n=3 the labelled set still moves between identical runs; the noise floor narrows the instability without removing it, so the label is a hint about measurement, not a statement about the compiler.
entries.observed_consequence: reproducibility_expectations records the label set as may_move_across_runs, so a future difference is read correctly instead of investigated.
entries.binding_detail: value 'labels sampled in both timed orders; the retention-pair stages run once and are excluded rather than counted as unaffected'

entries.statement: A map may only be applied to the host it was generated against, and a module may only be accepted if its integrity holds.
entries.why: G6 enforces HOST_IDENTITY and MODULE_INTEGRITY structurally, and 29 falsification arms plus a weakened verifier show the enforcement is not vacuous.
entries.observed_consequence: Every swap the falsifier attempts is refused; the weakened verifier fails the arms it should fail.

entries.statement: No Mutable-AOT implementation work may begin before SEMANTIC-MAP FINAL.
entries.why: PM ruling closing #59. The direction was accepted; the implementation was not authorized, because the map is what would decide which declarations such a runtime may reuse.
entries.observed_consequence: Recorded so a CLEAN_REPRODUCTION here cannot be cited as a green light for that lane.

reproducibility_expectations.why: Two consecutive full G8 runs were compared. What must be identical, and what may legitimately move, is recorded here so a future difference is read correctly instead of investigated as a regression.
identical_across_runs: the falsifier outcome ids and their counts
the rebuilt probe identities, including the canonical AOT
the G5 reader accounting and subset verdict
may_move_across_runs: timing samples and every summary derived from them
the order-dependent label set -- observed moving from [map_refs] to none between two runs even WITH the noise gate, so the gate narrows the instability without removing it at n=3
